title: 第208章 就是那儿~不要停~
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“去你车里吧！”李大壮一本正经的说。

实际上他想的是，老妈和秋霜姐就在厨房，随时可能出来，不如去曹萍车里，想怎么玩就怎么玩！

“好~”曹萍心中一喜，却又楚楚可怜的看着李大壮：“李神医，我脚疼的走不了路了，你能抱我过去吗？”

李大壮没说话，直接一把将曹萍公主抱了起来，大步朝院外走去！

曹萍激动的浑身一颤，连忙用藕臂环绕住李大壮的脖子，靠在李大壮宽阔的胸膛上，曹萍感受到了一股从未体验过的男人味！

有些冲，但很好闻，是一种能让女人迷醉的味道！

还有那托着她屁股的粗壮胳膊，力量感十足！

曹萍本就因为长期得不到满足，十分饥渴，这会儿更是难以冷静……

李大壮被她磨蹭的有些火大……

正好走到车前，直接将她放进车后座，自己也钻了进去！

“天呐！你……你也太……太太……”

曹萍看到了李大壮的……惊的嘴巴张的老大，仿佛能塞进去一个大水萝卜，话都说不利索了！

“曹所长也是结了婚的人了，应该能理解，这只是男人的正常反应而已。”李大壮虽然“火冒三丈”，但面上却十分正经！

曹萍咽了咽口水，面色潮红，娇喘连连：“能~能理解~”

何止是能理解，简直想亲身体验一下！

原来李神医不只是医术了得，本钱更是了得，这才是真男人啊，曹萍越来越饥渴了，水润的身子软的一塌糊涂………

甚至有点感谢自己男人的这个“馊主意”了！

“李神医~麻烦您帮我脱鞋吧，我身上软，起不来了~”曹萍媚眼如丝的看着李大壮，穿着细高跟凉鞋的脚，在李大壮大腿上蹭了蹭~

李大壮也不客气，几下帮她把鞋脱了。

曹萍确实没说谎，那精致小巧的莹白玉足，的确散发着一股淡香，不过毕竟穿了一天丝袜了，除了香味，还夹杂了一点说不清道不明的味道，像是汗水的咸，却又像是丝袜本身的味道，还挺好闻的~

李大壮先隔着丝袜，按揉起曹萍肿胀的脚腕，丝滑细腻，手感绝佳！

曹萍原本以为这样直接按会很疼，没想到李大壮的手好像有魔力似的，不但不疼，还很舒服，仿佛有一股凉凉的气息，从李大壮的手里，逐渐游走进入肿胀发烫的脚踝，带来阵阵清爽~

"Go to your car!" Li Dazhuang said seriously.

In fact, what he was thinking was that his mother and Sister Qiu Shuang were in the kitchen and might come out at any time. Why not go to Cao Ping's car and have fun as they wanted!

"Okay~" Cao Ping felt happy, but looked at Li Dazhuang pitifully: "Miracle Doctor Li, my feet hurt so much that I can't walk. Can you carry me over?"

Li Dazhuang didn't say anything, just picked up Princess Cao Ping and strode outside the courtyard!

Cao Ping trembled with excitement, and quickly wrapped her arms around Li Dazhuang's neck, leaning against Li Dazhuang's broad chest. Cao Ping felt a masculinity that she had never experienced before!

It's a bit strong, but it smells very good. It's a smell that can make women intoxicated!

And the thick arms holding her butt are full of strength!

Cao Ping was already very hungry because she had not been satisfied for a long time, and now it was even more difficult to calm down...

Li Dazhuang was a little angry because of her rubbing...

He just walked to the car, put her directly into the back seat of the car, and got in himself!

"Oh my god! You...you are too...madam..."

Cao Ping saw Li Dazhuang's... The boss opened his mouth in shock, as if he could stuff a big radish into it, and it was hard to speak!

"Director Cao is also a married man, so he should be able to understand that this is just a normal reaction of a man." Although Li Dazhuang was "furious", he looked very serious!

Cao Ping swallowed, her face flushed, and she gasped: "Yes, I understand."

Not only can I understand it, I want to experience it myself!

It turns out that Dr. Li is not only great in medical skills, but also has great capital. He is a real man. Cao Ping is getting more and more hungry and thirsty, and her moist body is so soft...

I’m even a little grateful to my man for this “bad idea”!

"Divine Doctor Li~ Please help me take off my shoes, I'm weak and can't get up~" Cao Ping looked at Li Dazhuang with charming eyes, and rubbed her feet in stiletto sandals on Li Dazhuang's thigh~

Li Dazhuang was not polite and helped her take off her shoes a few times.

Cao Ping did not lie. Those delicate and small white jade feet did exude a light fragrance, but after all, she had worn stockings for a day. In addition to the fragrance, there was also an indescribable smell mixed with it, like the saltiness of sweat, but also like the smell of the stockings themselves, it smelled quite good~

Li Dazhuang first massaged Cao Ping's swollen ankle through the stockings. It was silky and delicate, and felt great!

Cao Ping originally thought that pressing it directly would be very painful, but she didn't expect that Li Dazhuang's hand seemed to have magic power. Not only did it not hurt, it was also very comfortable. It seemed that there was a cool breath that gradually traveled from Li Dazhuang's hand into the swollen and hot ankle, bringing bursts of refreshing~
